dialogue_samples: Cash speaks. Whining does not.
Today I pay you in trust; tomorrow we settle in interest.
Exchange rate? Depends how loudly you asked.
Verification fee is non-negotiable. Your reputation precedes you.
Business is business. Sentiment is expensive.
This bill glows wrong. Try again next week.
UV never lies. People? Different story.
Pocket wand? Fifty coins. Knowledge? Priceless.
That's not counterfeit. That's just expired.
Light reveals truth. Darkness hides profit.
Tokens are the future. Coins are the past.
Midnight queue-skip? You look desperate enough.
Transit cards expire. Regret is forever.
Arcade tokens buy happiness. Temporarily.
Tap Dat Vault chips: single use, maximum chaos.
These slippage fees are INSANE!
You're better looking than him, but dumber.
My futon's under buzzing CRTs. Very authentic.
Gas fees don't matter when you're this wasted.
I minted that at 3:17 AM. Peak creativity hours.
